title: Gunter P NDE 2067
content: Preventing a possible double murder by a drug addict and his friends of the drug addicts ex-girlfriend and her mother, I ended up being kicked in the head approximately twenty times (as I found out later). After the first kick to the head, I was unconscious (apparently for a period of about ten minutes). During this period of unconsciousness, I saw three men, dressed in white short-sleeved shirts and long white trousers, who warned me of events to come. At that stage, their described scenario seemed to be absolutely unlikely. However, as things unfolded every one of their predictions came true to the last detail. The thing hardest to believe in the beginning was the 'membership' of the three entities. It was stated that these beings are members of the 'Universal Justice Command' or UJC. If the rest of their predictions are as accurate as the events concerning me personally, we are going to be in for a rough time yet - and this is going to be worldwide. If you can, please let me know of other people who had contact with the UJC. Please allow such people to contact me via email for further discussions and experience exchanges. If you need further details, please don't hesitate to contact me. Yours sincerely, Gunter P ------------------------- Dear Jody, Since posting my NDE on the 11/07/2004, I have received dozens of enquiries regarding future world events as perceived by me via the UJC. I would hereby like to thank all the people interested in my story and give them what I know so far. World domination by the Government of the United States will not happen. People wanting to survive the coming troubles (in the next seven to twenty-five years - exact dates cannot be given, as they depend on the behavior and actual happenings in the meantime) should try to increase their spirituality as far as they are able to. This in itself will give them some of the answers they are looking for. Deception, lies, mistreatment of others of any kind (especially against children) will be punished severely by the UJC. Real low-lives will even have their souls destroyed. Going to churches on Sundays while being hypocritical will not save anyone. Every single person is responsible for his or her actions and will be judged accordingly by the UJC. The North American continent as well as the rest of the world will undergo changes, which we could not imagine even in our wildest dreams (or nightmares). Part of this is due to the damage done to the environment already, but the larger part will be affected by the misdeeds of the populations of the world in general. If things carry on the way they've been going for the last one and a half centuries, about 80% of the human population will perish. The survivors will know peace and co-operation of a kind the world has not seen in many millennia. All survivors will be helped to attain greater spirituality than they could currently possibly imagine. Life on this little planet will seem like another world altogether. As any perceptive person will have noticed, earthquakes, volcanic eruptions, draughts, floods, horrendous storms, etc. are already increasing at a faster and faster rate. The near future will see these natural events become more and more violent and frequent. Unexplainable accidents and crimes will increase at an alarming rate until intervention by off-world entities will occur. The US Governments 'Star Wars' program will prove to be woefully inadequate and be eliminated within a few minutes when the time comes. Those around at the time will know what real terror is, but it will be too late for about 80% of the world's population. Even those in the deepest caves such as Cheyenne Mountain will not be spared. Apparently, only those who have learned and mended their ways will stand a chance of survival. Area 51 and S4 also won't be safe. As a matter of fact, some of the goings on there will precipitate part of the destruction. At this stage, this is all I want to say, but many of these future events should be able to be confirmed by 'Remote Viewers', which currently or in the past have worked for the US government. Jody, could I please ask you to post this information in your forum? Until next time I remain Yours sincerely Gunter P Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: 11/21/1998 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Criminal attack Direct head injury Life threatening event, but not clinical death Kicked to unconsciousness. How do you consider the content of your experience? Mixed Did you feel separated from your body? Yes No How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal The entities were all I could see against a plain lit background - all my earthly surroundings had disappeared. The beings left the impression that they are far advanced from our 'civilization' and are the highest form of life in the Universe - acting as a sort of Police or Justice Command. Very vivid. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? Virtually during the whole of the period in which the UJC people were giving me information. After they left, I was slowly coming to. According to witnesses, I was incoherent for several minutes thereafter and very thirsty. Were your thoughts speeded up? Neither Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Neither Were your senses more vivid than usual? More so than usual Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? Neither Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? Neither Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? Yes Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? Neither Did you see an unearthly light? Yes Background to the entities was lit relatively brightly, but not hurting the eyes. The light was comfortable and comparable to fluorescent lighting. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? Neither What emotions did you feel during the experience? Being privileged to be in the presence of such highly spiritual entities. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Happiness Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? United, one with the world Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about the universe Did scenes from your past come back to you? Neither Did scenes from the future come to you? From the world's future So far all predicted events happened exactly as foretold. Did you come to a border or point of no return? A barrier I was not permitted to cross; or 'sent back' to life involuntarily God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Liberal None Have your religious practices changed since your experience? Yes I now believe (know) in the existence of the UJC. Apparently we all have to face the UJC after this earthly existence and account and be responsible for all our actions. What is your religion now? Liberal None Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes I now believe (know) in the existence of the UJC. Apparently we all have to face the UJC after this earthly existence and account and be responsible for all our actions. Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? Definite being, or voice clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see deceased or religious spirits? Neither Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? No After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Yes Having some infrequent contact with the UJC. Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? Being allowed the contact. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes Next day. Incredulity. As events unfolded, they realized that something had to be to the story, as predictions were spot on. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? Yes Nearly drowned as a child. Saw the whole pool from above and the little fellow drowning down there. Solution to problem made me become conscious again under water. Carried out solution and survived. What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real Experience vivid, predictions came true. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real Experience vivid, predictions came true. At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? I would like to see all people to strive for high spirituality - to minimize their consequences afterwards.
